description.from: Delete tracked console.log, junit-reports/, results/, tmp_crawl_debug/, _demo_embedding_retrieval/, project.kanbus.bak/, src/biblicus/inference.py,cover and CHANGELOG_STT_BENCHMARKING.md; add .gitignore rules; keep .coveragerc as the only coverage config and delete the dead [tool.coverage] section in pyproject.toml; stop ignoring the reinforcement memory pytest suites in scripts/test.py and make them pass.
description.to:
## Goal
Remove tracked build and run artifacts, make `.coveragerc` the single coverage configuration, and run the reinforcement memory suites in CI.

## State when stopped
Branch `claude/project-thread-dmru5y-repo-hygiene` is pushed with 5 commits plus one `wip:` commit. It already has: removal of tracked run artifacts with `.gitignore` rules, STT benchmarking milestone notes folded into the benchmarking guide, a merge of main as of PR 56, and an unverified edit that deletes the `[tool.coverage]` sections from `pyproject.toml`. Nothing has been installed, linted or tested.

## Remaining work
1. Merge current `origin/main` (it now has PR 60, PR 61, v1.11.4) into the branch.
2. Confirm every path below is gone from git and ignored: `console.log`, `junit-reports/`, `results/`, `tmp_crawl_debug/`, `_demo_embedding_retrieval/`, `project.kanbus.bak/`, `src/biblicus/inference.py,cover`, `CHANGELOG_STT_BENCHMARKING.md`, `*.py,cover`. Before deleting, grep `features/`, `tests/`, `scripts/`, `docs/` for references. Keep `corpora/` and `raw/` content that tests or docs use.
3. In `.coveragerc` remove the omit of `analysis/reinforcement_memory`. In `scripts/test.py` remove the six `--ignore=tests/test_reinforcement_memory*.py` arguments.
4. Run the CI recipe from `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: `poetry install --with dev --extras datasets --extras web --extras markitdown`, `poetry run python tests/fixtures/fetch_wikitext2.py`, `poetry run ruff check src/biblicus/`, `poetry run python scripts/test.py`. If a reinforcement memory suite fails for a real bug, file a Kanbus bug under epic blbs-9d0c496d and ignore only that file. Set `fail_under` to the achieved whole-number coverage and say what it is. Do not edit AGENTS.md policy text here.
5. Fold in Kanbus blbs-5rt (Restore 100% coverage and fix coverage harness) if this makes it moot; otherwise comment on it.

## Done when
A PR to `main` is green on lint, tests (3.10 to 3.12), docs and CodeQL, with the achieved coverage number in the PR body.
